name: LooksRight
desc: Your agent says the page is done. LooksRight opens it and looks.
typing: Your agent says the page is done. LooksRight looks.
12 deterministic UI checks in a real Chrome
Every route, viewport and theme, no baseline images
Exit 1 breaks the build: that is the whole CI integration
tagline: Opens the page in a real Chrome and runs 12 deterministic checks against the rendered DOM. No baseline images, no service.
pitch: **LooksRight** closes the gap between green tests and a broken screen: it renders every route at phone, tablet and desktop, light and dark, and names the element and the number behind each finding, so you fix a line instead of squinting at a screenshot.
notice: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. "Claude" and "Claude Code" are Anthropic trademarks.

what.product: deterministic UI checker for agent-built frontends
what.scenes: route × viewport (phone, tablet, desktop) × theme (light, dark)
what.checks: 12 checks: blank page, overflow, contrast, tap targets, broken images and more
what.output: element + number per finding; exit 0 clean, 1 error, 2 could not run
what.browser: uses the Chrome or Edge you already have (playwright-core), no download
what.ci: one command after the app starts; no baseline, no snapshots, no account
